tasks.gr10-algebraic-expressions-t1: Topic: Algebraic Expressions. Cover expanding products of binomials, factorising (common factor, grouping, trinomials, difference of squares, sum and difference of cubes), simplifying and adding algebraic fractions with restrictions, rational and irrational numbers, and estimating and rounding surds. Ask Grade 10 learners to expand and factorise correctly, simplify fractions by cancelling whole factors, and classify numbers as rational or irrational.
tasks.gr10-exponents-t1: Topic: Exponents. Cover the laws of exponents with integer and rational exponents, zero and negative exponents, simplifying expressions, and solving simple exponential equations by writing both sides with the same base. Ask Grade 10 learners to simplify, evaluate and solve; avoid surd simplification (Grade 11).
tasks.gr10-number-patterns-t1: Topic: Number Patterns. Cover linear number patterns, the common difference, the general term Tn = dn + c, finding a term, and finding the term number from a value. Ask Grade 10 learners to extend patterns, find general terms and use them in contexts such as matchstick shapes.
tasks.gr10-equations-inequalities-t1: Topic: Equations and Inequalities. Cover linear equations, quadratic equations solved by factorisation, literal equations (changing the subject of a formula), simultaneous linear equations by elimination and substitution, linear inequalities and interval notation, and word problems that lead to equations. Ask Grade 10 learners to solve, check solutions and write inequality answers correctly, including reversing the sign when dividing by a negative.
tasks.gr10-trigonometry-t1: Topic: Trigonometry. Cover sin, cos and tan and their reciprocals in right-angled triangles, special angles 30, 45 and 60 degrees with exact values, ratios for angles 0 to 360 degrees on the Cartesian plane (point (x; y), r, quadrants and signs), solving right-angled triangles for sides and angles, and simple trigonometric equations. Ask Grade 10 learners to use the right ratio, give exact values and round correctly.
